item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. You've stacked the evening well — relaxation, a wind-down ritual, and a fixed bedtime are all on the calendar. That structure only works if you protect it: don't let the day's noise creep into that window. When the pre-bed routine starts, treat it as non-negotiable, not optional. One action: when the wind-down block hits, put the phone away first, everything else follows from that.
